title: TRAILS: Trajectory Generation for Automated Indoor Locomotion Studies
title_zh: TRAILS：用于自动化室内运动研究的轨迹生成
abstract: Virtual reality experiments involving navigation and simulated robot motion often require large, realistic environments and numerous distinct trajectories to avoid repetitive navigation while providing sufficient variation for controlled experiments. Designing such scenarios manually is labor-intensive, particularly when trajectories must satisfy predefined geometric and kinematic constraints while remaining diverse and comparable across experimental conditions. This paper presents TRAILS, an automated framework for generating complete virtual navigation scenarios consisting of an environment layout, a path, and a time-parameterized motion profile. The framework combines a constraint-based procedural environment generator inspired by Wave Function Collapse, trajectory generation using optimized cubic Bézier curves, and speed-profile generation subject to kinematic constraints. The generated scenarios provide diverse indoor environments with corridors, open spaces, and obstacles, together with trajectories of identical duration that vary in path geometry, wall proximity, and velocity profiles while minimizing systematic dependencies between these characteristics. The framework is designed as an easy-to-use tool requiring only a small number of intuitive user-defined parameters to automatically generate large sets of distinct navigation scenarios satisfying prescribed geometric and kinematic constraints. By relying on explicit, seed-controlled algorithmic procedures rather than data-driven models, the generated scenarios remain transparent, reproducible, and configurable, making the framework well suited for telepresence and human-subject experiments. The code is available at https://github.com/JucciK/Trails .
abstract_zh: 涉及导航和模拟机器人运动的虚拟现实实验通常需要大型、逼真的环境以及众多不同的轨迹，以避免重复导航，同时为受控实验提供足够的变化。手动设计此类场景是劳动密集型的，尤其是当轨迹必须满足预定义的几何和运动学约束，同时在实验条件之间保持多样性和可比性时。本文提出了TRAILS，一个自动化框架，用于生成完整的虚拟导航场景，包括环境布局、路径和时间参数化的运动轮廓。该框架结合了受波函数坍缩启发的基于约束的程序化环境生成器、使用优化三次贝塞尔曲线的轨迹生成，以及受运动学约束的速度轮廓生成。生成的场景提供了具有走廊、开放空间和障碍物的多样化室内环境，以及持续时间相同但路径几何、墙壁接近度和速度轮廓各异的轨迹，同时最小化这些特征之间的系统依赖性。该框架设计为一个易于使用的工具，仅需少量直观的用户定义参数即可自动生成大量满足规定几何和运动学约束的不同导航场景。通过依赖显式的、种子控制的算法程序而非数据驱动模型，生成的场景保持透明、可重现和可配置，使得该框架非常适合远程呈现和人类受试者实验。代码可在https://github.com/JucciK/Trails获取。
tldr_zh: TRAILS框架自动生成满足约束的虚拟导航场景。
cover_zh: 告别手工设计！TRAILS一键生成多样虚拟导航场景
